The Beautiful Place Matt Dinniman.description: Matt Cruse has found his place in the sky, working as a cabin boy aboard the *Aurora* — a grand airship that carries wealthy passengers between cities, cruising hundreds of feet above the ocean. He feels born to it, as weightless and buoyant as the hydrium gas that keeps his ship aloft. Then a dying balloonist speaks of beautiful winged creatures drifting through the high air, and Matt files the old man's words away as feverish fantasy. That changes when he meets the balloonist's granddaughter, and the clues start lining up: the creatures are real, they are mysterious, and someone else wants to find them first. The skies above this world are crowded with transcontinental voyagers and pirates, and whatever is up there has never been dreamed of by the humans who sail beneath it.
The Beautiful Place Matt Dinniman.title: Airborn

The Beautiful Place Matt Dinniman.description: I'm one of Hollywood's A-listers, and I've got the whole industry in the palm of my hand — except my playboy image is about to tank my career. No more tabloid headlines, no more parties, and absolutely no more one-night stands. So I ship out to the coast of Maine to film my latest blockbuster, fully committed to staying out of trouble. Then trouble finds me. Her name is Lana Kelly. She's never heard of Matt Easton. My million-dollar smile doesn't even make a dent. And when I figure out she's my neighbor — roughly ten yards away — I know I'm completely done for. She's got a mouth designed for pleasure and legs that would wrap perfectly around my waist, and she is movie-star beautiful without an ounce of interest in the glitz and glamour of Hollywood. Getting Lana into my bed is harder than I'm used to. A lot harder. But I'm determined to convince her the best place in the world is on the red carpet, holding my hand. I could have any woman on the planet. All I want is the girl next door.
The Beautiful Place Matt Dinniman.title: Hollywood Scandal

Star Wars Omnibus: X-Wing Rogue Squadron.description: The Republic Fair is drawing visitors from across the galaxy to the planet Valo for a grand celebration, but Jedi Padawan Ram Jomaram would rather tinker in his dingy garage than join the festivities. When a security alarm sounds from the hilltop known as Crashpoint Peak, Ram grabs his droid V-18 and goes to investigate. He finds Valo's communications tower sabotaged — an ominous signal that the fair itself is under threat. Before he can warn the Jedi, the Nihil launch their surprise assault. Now Ram must hold the line at Crashpoint Tower and get a distress call out to the Republic, with help arriving from some unexpected new friends.
series: Star Wars: The High Republic (Middle Grade)

seriesWithId.title: Star Wars: The High Republic (Middle Grade)

Star Wars Omnibus: X-Wing Rogue Squadron.subtitle: Star Wars: The High Republic (Middle Grade), Book 2
Star Wars Omnibus: X-Wing Rogue Squadron.title: Star Wars: the High Republic: Race to Crashpoint Tower

X-Wing Rogue Squadron Stackpole.description: Sleek, swift, and lethal — the X-wing is the Rebel Alliance's sharpest weapon, and the pilots who fly them are the edge of that blade. When Rebel hero Wedge Antilles rebuilds the legendary Rogue Squadron, he wants only the galaxy's most daring jockeys, the ones who can survive near-suicidal missions against a battle-hardened Imperial foe that still controls vast reaches of space. Training is brutal, the weeding relentless, and Antilles makes no secret of the cost: even with the best flyers alive, many won't come back. The name Rogue Squadron is meant to strike fear into enemy hearts, and earning that reputation demands everything these hard-bitten warriors have. Their trial comes at Blackmoon, a heavily fortified Imperial stronghold where the order goes out and even the bravest have to ask whether anyone flies home.
X-Wing Rogue Squadron Stackpole.subtitle: Star Wars Legends
X-Wing Rogue Squadron Stackpole.title: Rogue Squadron

X-Wing Rogue Squadron Stackpole.description: The Rebel Alliance's elite X-wing pilots face a mission with no clean way out. Wedge Antilles and Rogue Squadron stage a raid on an enemy stronghold that goes sideways—only to be pulled from certain destruction by Ysanne Isard, the ruthless Imperial commander who has spent her career trying to wipe them out. Isard proposes an alliance: she will help Wedge rescue his captured comrades from Admiral Krennel's sadistic prison camp, provided Rogue Squadron fights alongside her against an enemy of her own making. Wedge knows she will betray them. He also knows he cannot abandon his people to Krennel. The trap is obvious; walking into it is the only option left.
X-Wing Rogue Squadron Stackpole.subtitle: Star Wars Legends
X-Wing Rogue Squadron Stackpole.title: Isard's Revenge

X-Wing Rogue Squadron Stackpole.description: Wedge Antilles and Rogue Squadron fly their sleek, deadly X-wings into the Empire's beating heart: Coruscant, the towering city-world where Imperial High Command wages its war. Their mission is espionage, not combat — infiltrate the capital, gather the intelligence the Rebel Alliance needs, and survive long enough to bring the Empire to its knees. Capture means death, or worse, a living captivity under Ysanne Isard — "Iceheart," the ruthless figure who now rules in all but name. And the danger already runs inside the squadron itself: one of Wedge's own pilots is Iceheart's hidden agent, wearing a mask of innocence while working to betray every colleague and the Rebellion along with them.
X-Wing Rogue Squadron Stackpole.subtitle: Star Wars Legends: Rogue Squadron, Book 2
X-Wing Rogue Squadron Stackpole.title: Wedge's Gamble: Star Wars Legends

X-Wing Rogue Squadron Stackpole.description: Imperial mastermind Ysanne Isard, fresh from a failed viral assault on Coruscant, seizes control of the galaxy's bacta production on Thyferra — masking her grab for the New Republic's most vital medicinal resource behind a corporate power struggle. Rogue Squadron burns to liberate the planet and free Isard's prisoners, but New Republic politics threaten to reassign them elsewhere. Out of time and options, Wedge Antilles, Corran Horn, and their fellow pilots resign their commissions to fight Isard as an independent force. They chip away at her grip on Thyferra, facing down Star Destroyers with whatever ships and allies they can scrape together. Then Isard discovers the rogues' hidden base, and a desperate last-stand battle erupts against her overwhelming fleet.
X-Wing Rogue Squadron Stackpole.subtitle: Star Wars: Legends(Rogue Squadron, Book 4)
X-Wing Rogue Squadron Stackpole.title: The Bacta War: Star Wars Legends
